explanation: The Visium builder follows HYPOMAP's conventions: regional-cluster names from the authors' abbreviation table, every donor x region cell as a sample with no minimum, no compartments, Unassigned flagged and unranked, and per-condition poolWeights so a region's value is the CPM of all its spots. Region names, the absence of a minimum-spot or sparse rule, and pooling every spot to summarise a region follow the HYPOMAP authors (Tadross et al. 2025, Supplementary Table 20 and Methods). The Visium builder also ships the curated section images: it verifies every pinned file (bytes, SHA-256, WebP header size against frames.tsv, frame spots against sections.tsv, labels inside their frame, cluster colours against the 23 regional clusters) and writes them with sections/index.json; --fetch --sections re-renders them from the RDS and refuses any change. writeOrCheck in scripts/lib/externalReference.mts now writes and byte-compares Buffer products as well as text.
